title: Sources, connectors, and extraction
subtitle: Reliable knowledge starts with knowing what was actually scanned.
goal: Make document ingestion tell the truth about what it read
intro: A source scan must distinguish missing data from data it could not inspect.
terms: A complete view suitable for reconciliation
Progress known to be safely processed
flow: Update only from known source state
case: A document folder temporarily denies access to one file.
The old indexed file must not be deleted merely because the scan missed it.
Treating an incomplete scan as a complete empty source causes data loss.
